In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ALSA: emux: Fix UAF of soundfont zones at note-on

snd_emux_note_on() looks up the matching zones via
snd_soundfont_search_zone(), which takes sflist->lock only during the
lookup and returns the raw zone pointers after releasing it.  The
caller then stores them in vp->zone without any protection.
Meanwhile, a concurrent SNDRV_EMUX_IOCTL_REMOVE_LAST_SAMPLES ioctl may
unlink and free those zones in snd_soundfont_remove_unlocked(); this
leads to a use-after-free in snd_emux_note_on(), and later at
accessing the cached vp->zone, e.g. in snd_emux_send_effect().

Fix it by holding sflist->lock in snd_emux_note_on() over the whole
zone lookup and voice setup, and let snd_soundfont_search_zone()
require the caller to hold the lock, instead.
snd_soundfont_lock_preset() takes sflist->lock for setting
presets_locked, so the removal path now syncs with the note-on finish.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

usb: gadget: fix refcount underflow in gadgetfs_bind() error path

gadgetfs_bind() calls get_dev() only on the success path, but
gadgetfs_unbind() called from the enomem error label unconditionally
calls put_dev().  When bind fails (e.g. ENOMEM), put_dev() fires
without a matching get_dev(), leaving the refcount unbalanced.

A subsequent close of the ep0 file descriptor calls dev_release() ->
put_dev() which hits zero and frees the object; then gadgetfs_kill_sb()
calls put_dev(the_device) again on the already-freed pointer, triggering
a refcount underflow and use-after-free.

Fix by calling get_dev() at the start of gadgetfs_bind(), before any
error path that invokes gadgetfs_unbind(), so the reference is always
balanced regardless of whether bind succeeds or fails.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: SVM: Trigger new ASID allocation in both VMCBs on pCPU switch

When the pCPU where the VMCB was most recently used is switched, reset
the ASID generation in both VMCBs, triggering new ASID allocation for
the immediate VMRUN as well as the next VMRUN on the other VMCB.

The ASID is shared between vmcb01 and vmcb02, and gets flushed on every
nested transition. However, since pCPU tracking is done per VMCB, it is
possible for one VMCB to allocate a new ASID when migrated to a new
pCPU, and then the other VMCB reuses that ASID on the old pCPU. This can
result in the same ASID being used by multiple vCPUs on the old pCPU.

Example scenario:
- vCPU runs on pCPU A, vmcb01 is active, asid=1.
- vCPU migrates to pCPU B, vmcb01 pCPU changes, new asid=2.
- Another vCPU runs on pCPU A and allocates asid=2 as well.
- vCPU migrates back to pCPU A, and then switches to vmcb02 before it
  runs again with vmcb01.
- No pCPU switch is detected for vmcb02, so VMRUN is done with asid=2.
- Two vCPUs end up using asid=2 on the same pCPU.

Keep the VMCB dirtying to the active VMCB only. Clean bits are tracked
by a pCPU for each VMCB, so do not unnecessarily dirty a VMCB if its
pCPU does not change.

Additionally, initialize the tracked pCPU for vmcb02 to -1 on nested
enablement as hardening, so that a new ASID allocation is always
triggered when nested is disabled and re-enabled.

No performance regression was noticed when overcommitting L1 vCPUs in L0
(to force rescheduling), pinning L1 <-> L2 vCPUs, and running CPUID in a
tight loop bouncing between 2 vCPUs in L2.

An alternative (and perhaps more proper) fix would be tracking the ASID
per-VMCB instead (e.g. [1]). However, that's a more involved change, and
it would result in having different ASIDs for L1 and L2 without actually
properly maintaining them. It would probably work because all TLB
flushes target the current VMCB, and the other VMCB is always flushed on
nested transitions, but the code ends up in an arguably more fragile
state. Punt a proper clean fix to an incoming (and overdue) overhaul of
SVM's ASID usage [2].

[1] https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20250205182402.2147495-2-yosry.ahmed@linux.dev
[2] https://lore.kernel.org/kvm/20260728003557.1136583-1-yosry@kernel.org

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: nSVM: Ignore EFER.LMA if EFER.LME=0 when preparing L2 state

Force EFER.LMA=0 if EFER.LME=0 when preparing L2 state for VMRUN, i.e.
mimic real hardware's behavior of ignoring EFER.LMA if EFER.LME=0.  VMRUN
unfortunately allows the nonsensical combination, i.e. doesn't fail, but
KVM itself has an invariant EFER.LMA can be set et if and only if EFER.LME
is set.   Breaking that invariant can lead to a variety of issue,
particularly in MMU code that keys off EFER.LMA when determining whether to
emulate/virtualization 4/5-level paging versus PAE paging.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86/mmu: Bug the VM if KVM attempts to walk more levels than the MMU has

Extend the "EFER.LMA && !CR4.PAE" check, which exists largely to guard
against KVM configuring a paging32 MMU with more than 2 levels of paging,
with a very explicit check for exactly that: that KVM isn't trying to walk
more levels of paging than the MMU template provides.  I.e. harden KVM
against all bugs that would cause KVM to generates accesses beyond the
bounds of guest_walker's arrays, regardless of how KVM ended up with the
misconfigured MMU.

Note, don't use w->cpu_role.base.level directly as the paging64 template
only provides two levels of page tables for PAE paging on 32-bit hosts, and
handles the third level by manually emulating the PDPTR access.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: logitech-hidpp: fix race condition when accessing stale stack pointer

The driver uses hidpp->send_receive_buf to point to a stack-allocated
buffer in the synchronous command path (__do_hidpp_send_message_sync).
However, this pointer is not cleared when the function returns.

If an event is processed (e.g. by a different thread) while the
send_mutex is held by a new command, but before that command has
updated send_receive_buf, the handler (hidpp_raw_hidpp_event) will
observe that the mutex is locked and dereference the stale pointer.

This results in an out-of-bounds access on a different thread's kernel
stack (or a NULL pointer dereference on the very first command).

Fix this by:
1. Clearing hidpp->send_receive_buf to NULL before releasing the mutex
   in the synchronous command path.
2. Moving the assignment of the local 'question' and 'answer' pointers
   inside the mutex_is_locked() block in the handler, and adding
   a NULL check before dereferencing.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

speakup: Fix NULL pointer dereference on VT switch + selection

When selecting/pasting very quickly after VT switch, the tty is not set

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

netfilter: conntrack: tcp: use UNACK timeout for non-closing RST packets

Commit be0502a3f2e9 ("netfilter: conntrack: tcp: only close if RST
matches exact sequence") keeps an established conntrack entry in
ESTABLISHED when an in-window RST does not match the expected sequence
number exactly, so the endpoint can validate the RST with a challenge
ACK.

The timeout selection nevertheless uses the CLOSE timeout for every RST
packet.  The bug is that timeout selection is based on the packet type,
not on the state transition result: even when RST validation keeps
new_state in ESTABLISHED, the timeout is still forced to
TCP_CONNTRACK_CLOSE.

Linux TCP independently rate limits challenge ACKs per socket.  A second
non-exact RST can therefore arrive after the first challenge ACK has
restored the timeout but before the rate limit expires.  The second RST
lowers the timeout to 10 seconds again while the endpoint suppresses the
second challenge ACK, allowing the conntrack entry to expire while both
TCP endpoints remain established.

Using the ESTABLISHED timeout for such RSTs would avoid this short
expiration window, but it could also retain stale entries for the
five-day default because conntrack cannot reliably match the endpoint's
exact TCP state.

Use the UNACK timeout for RST packets that leave the conntrack entry in
TCP_CONNTRACK_ESTABLISHED.  Exact-match RSTs and accepted RST packet
trains still fall through to timeouts[new_state], which preserves the
CLOSE timeout when conntrack accepts the RST as closing the flow.

This avoids the aggressive 10-second expiration window for non-exact
RSTs while preserving the short timeout for RSTs that conntrack accepts
as closing the flow.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: reserve space for the UTF-16 terminator in stream info

smb_strtoUTF16() always writes a terminating zero UTF-16 unit after the
converted characters, but get_file_stream_info() budgets only
sizeof(struct smb2_file_stream_info) + streamlen * 2 for a stream entry
and sizeof(struct smb2_file_stream_info) + 7 * 2 for the trailing
"::$DATA" entry. When an entry exactly fills the 448-byte small response
buffer, the terminator is written two bytes past the allocation.

Reserve one extra UTF-16 unit in both budget checks. The terminator is
not part of the wire format, so the reported lengths are unchanged.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback: Fix UAF when reading statistics data

The network statistic data in the driver is protected by RCU.
Unfortunately when tearing down the queues after an error during
connecting to the frontend (e.g. due to illegal Xenstore data filled
in by the guest), the statistic data is being freed without
synchronizing the RCU state.  In case the data is being read via sysfs
in this phase, access to already freed memory or memory being in new
use is possible.

Fix that by calling synchronize_net() before freeing the queue data.

This is XSA-526 / CVE-2026-100080

Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability in ninenines cowlib (cow_http_te module) allows Excessive Allocation.

The chunked transfer-encoding parser in cow_http_te accepts an unbounded number of hex digits in the chunk-size field. Each digit causes a bignum multiplication (Len * 16 + digit), so parsing N hex digits requires O(N²) CPU work and O(N) memory. Additionally, when input is drip-fed, the parser discards the accumulated length on each partial read and restarts from zero on resumption, raising the cost to O(N³). An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by sending an HTTP/1.1 request with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and a very long chunk-size hex string to cause denial of service through CPU exhaustion and memory amplification.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/cow_http_te.erl and program routines cow_http_te:stream_chunked/2, cow_http_te:chunked_len/4.

This issue affects cowlib: from 0.6.0 before 2.16.1.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.4, 10.2.8, 10.0.11, and 9.4.16, a low-privileged user who holds the "power" Splunk role could inject malicious content into a Splunk Web view. When another authenticated user opens the affected view in Splunk Web, the injected content executes unauthorized JavaScript code within the viewing user's browser session.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Web does not properly validate content in a view definition before rendering the view.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to improper TLS certificate validation in the GDP Terraform provider, allowing a network attacker with a man-in-the-middle position to intercept sensitive credentials transmitted to the Guardium appliance.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to SQL injection in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access or modify sensitive database information.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to create and run playbooks could start child playbooks on containers outside the authorized label, or repository scope for that user. This could expose container data and affect automation outside that scope.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not bind the identity used to authorize the child playbook run to the parent playbook execution context.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.4, 10.2.8, 10.0.11, and 9.4.16, an unauthenticated user could craft a malicious link that, if opened by an authenticated user, executes arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) searches with the victim's permissions. 
Successful exploitation could allow the unauthenticated user to access or modify data, alter Splunk platform configurations, and disrupt operations available to the affected user.
The vulnerability is possible because the Portable Document Format (PDF) generation component processes request data before it rejects deprecated GET requests and does not apply SPL safeguards for risky commands to subsearches.
For more information see Generate PDFs of your reports and dashboards (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/create-dashboards-and-reports/reporting-manual/10.4/report-management/generate-pdfs-of-your-reports-and-dashboards) and SPL safeguards for risky commands (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.4/best-practices-for-splunk-platform-security/spl-safeguards-for-risky-commands) in the Splunk documentation.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could read or overwrite persisted data for playbook runs outside the authorized label, or ownership scope for that user. The affected data can include playbook inputs, prompt and block results, outputs, and secrets that playbooks save in run data. Overwriting the data could corrupt results that paused, scheduled, or parent playbook runs later use.
The vulnerability is possible because the playbook automation APIs do not bind data operations to the active playbook run.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a low-privileged user who holds the "power" Splunk role could inject arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands into a Classic Dashboard search. When another user opens the affected dashboard in Splunk Web, those injected commands execute with the viewing user's permissions, potentially allowing the low-privileged user to access stored credentials and write data to indexes.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise does not correctly escape user-supplied content when it rewrites a search, which lets the rewritten search include additional SPL commands.
The vulnerability requires another user to open the dashboard in Splunk Web. Consequently, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role should not be able to exploit the vulnerability at will.
For more information see SPL safeguards for risky commands (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.6/best-practices-for-splunk-platform-security/spl-safeguards-for-risky-commands) and Define roles on the Splunk platform with capabilities (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.6/manage-splunk-platform-users-and-roles/define-roles-on-the-splunk-platform-with-capabilities) in the Splunk documentation.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with local access to the affected host could obtain a live Splunk SOAR session token or decrypted asset configuration when another user starts an App Editor debug action.
The vulnerability is possible because App Editor debug actions expose sensitive runtime information to other local users on the affected host.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role could add attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) to a shared dashboard. When another user opens the dashboard in Splunk Web, Splunk Enterprise could run the attacker-controlled SPL using the permissions of that dashboard viewer. The attacker-controlled SPL could expose stored credentials, modify indexed data, and reduce availability.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise does not neutralize special elements in search filter values before it builds optimized search jobs.
The vulnerability requires the attacker to phish the affected user by tricking them into initiating a request within their browser. The attacker should not be able to exploit the vulnerability at will.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role could craft a shared Classic Dashboard that runs arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands for another authenticated user. Exploitation requires the dashboard viewer to open the shared dashboard. The injected commands could access data available to the dashboard viewer, modify data available to the dashboard viewer, and partially disrupt Splunk Enterprise.
For more information see Add sparklines to search results (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/search/search-manual/10.6/calculate-statistics/add-sparklines-to-search-results), Configure dashboard permissions (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/create-dashboards-and-reports/simple-xml-dashboards/10.6/manage-and-share-dashboards/configure-dashboard-permissions), and SPL safeguards for risky commands (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.6/best-practices-for-splunk-platform-security/spl-safeguards-for-risky-commands) in the Splunk documentation.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an unauthenticated user could gain administrator privileges through a user account that receives an unintended role. A user that holds a role with permission to create or modify users and assign roles must assign the target account a role with a numeric name through the user-management Representational State Transfer (REST) API.
The vulnerability is possible because the API resolves a numeric role name as a role identifier instead of preserving the requested role name.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could cause Splunk Enterprise to run arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) searches with elevated privileges through data model acceleration.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise does not correctly neutralize caller-supplied data model acceleration values before it places them into generated summarization searches.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds the "Observer" Splunk SOAR role could access a password-reset credential in a diagnostic log bundle and reset the password for an active local account.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not redact password-reset email bodies before it logs communications between product processes.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with access to the configured load balancer account could replace a load balancer helper that Splunk SOAR later runs with root privileges during cluster lifecycle operations. If a Splunk SOAR administrator performs a cluster lifecycle operation, Splunk SOAR could execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the load balancer.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify the integrity or ownership of the load balancer helper before running it with root privileges.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Playbooks view, edit, execute, and delete permissions could cause existing cross-repository playbook references to run attacker-controlled playbook code.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR can bind existing cross-repository playbook references to a different source control repository when a deleted repository name is reused.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use the Automation Dependency Wheel Representational State Transfer (REST) API to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory, which could lead to arbitrary code execution.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not restrict uploaded automation dependency wheel filenames to the intended storage directory.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to execute arbitrary code on the host when the user validates an installed app.
The vulnerability is possible because the app validation workflow does not isolate untrusted code from the trusted environment.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use a customer automation dependency to execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not properly separate customer automation dependencies from trusted product code.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with only the apps:edit permission could install a connector app that causes Splunk SOAR to write attacker-controlled files outside the app directory. This could let the user modify files used by Splunk SOAR and execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR constructs the dependency installation command from app-supplied metadata without preventing that metadata from changing its arguments.
For more information see Manage roles and permissions in Splunk SOAR (On-premises) (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-soar/soar-on-premises/administer-soar-on-premises/8.8.0/manage-your-splunk-soar-on-premises-users-and-accounts/manage-roles-and-permissions-in-splunk-soar-on-premises) and Add and configure apps and assets to provide actions in Splunk SOAR (On-premises) (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-soar/soar-on-premises/administer-soar-on-premises/8.6.0/manage-your-splunk-soar-on-premises-apps-and-assets/add-and-configure-apps-and-assets-to-provide-actions-in-splunk-soar-on-premises) in the Splunk documentation.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR by installing a malicious app.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not restrict app dependencies to validated binary packages before installing them.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could execute arbitrary code on the host that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because the Representational State Transfer (REST) API accepts package references from untrusted sources and passes them to the dependency installer.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in absinthe-graphql absinthe allows unauthenticated denial of service via atom table exhaustion when parsing attacker-controlled GraphQL SDL.

Multiple Blueprint.Draft.convert/2 implementations in Absinthe's SDL language modules call String.to_atom/1 on attacker-controlled names from parsed GraphQL SDL documents, including directive names, field names, type names, and argument names. Because atoms are never garbage-collected and the BEAM atom table has a fixed limit (default 1,048,576), each unique name permanently consumes one slot. An attacker can exhaust the atom table by submitting SDL documents containing enough unique names, causing the Erlang VM to abort with system_limit and taking down the entire node.

Any application that passes attacker-controlled GraphQL SDL through Absinthe's parser is exposed — for example, a schema-upload endpoint, a federation gateway that ingests remote SDL, or any developer tool that runs the parser over user-supplied documents.

This issue affects absinthe: from 1.5.0-alpha.2 before 1.10.2.

Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade.

The Phar extension selects the signature verification method from the signature type stored in the archive, and only the OpenSSL types consult the separate .pubkey file holding the trusted public key. An attacker who can modify an OpenSSL-signed Phar archive, but not its public key file, can switch the signature type to a keyless hash such as SHA-256 with a recomputed digest, so the altered archive passes verification even with phar.require_hash enabled. An application that loads the archive may then execute attacker-controlled PHP code. Native, tar-based and zip-based phars are affected.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Use-after-free in magic method backtraces can lead to remote code execution.

When collecting the arguments of a method call handled by __call() or __callStatic() for a backtrace, PHP can read stale values that may refer to freed memory. If a fatal error such as exceeding memory_limit occurs while an application enters such a call, with fatal_error_backtraces enabled (the default) and zend.exception_ignore_args disabled, a remote attacker who controls enough request data to influence memory allocation may cause memory corruption, crash the PHP worker or, with knowledge of memory addresses, execute arbitrary code. php.ini-production enables zend.exception_ignore_args, which prevents this.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution.

In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

PHP-FPM epoll use-after-free can lead to local privilege escalation.

When catch_workers_output is enabled and the epoll event backend is used, the PHP-FPM master can close a worker's output pipe in fpm_child_close() without removing the associated event, and the delayed cleanup can free the worker record while its epoll registration is still active. A later event is then dispatched through a pointer into freed memory. A local attacker who can execute PHP code in an FPM worker can crash the master or execute code with its privileges, commonly root. catch_workers_output is disabled by default but enabled in the official PHP-FPM Docker images.

This issue affects PHP versions from 8.1.20 through 8.1.34, from 8.2.7 before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS) vulnerability in absinthe-graphql absinthe_plug allows reflected cross-site scripting via the GraphiQL interface.

Absinthe.Plug.GraphiQL.js_escape/1 in lib/absinthe/plug/graphiql.ex escapes single quotes and newlines in the query GET parameter before embedding it in an inline JavaScript string, but does not escape backslashes. An attacker can bypass the escaping by prefixing a quote with a backslash (e.g. \'), breaking out of the string context and executing arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser.

This issue affects absinthe_plug: from 1.1.1 before 1.5.10.

A security flaw has been discovered in nodejs undici up to 7.24.0. This affects the function Object.assign of the file balanced-pool.js of the component BalancedPool. The manipulation results in improperly controlled modification of object prototype attributes. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 7.24.1 is able to mitigate this issue. The patch is identified as 0d7ec33ff37563d3e7c98d11d7bca736f330d156. You should upgrade the affected component.

Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in absinthe-graphql absinthe allows unauthenticated denial of service via quadratic fragment-name uniqueness validation.

Absinthe.Phase.Document.Validation.UniqueFragmentNames.run/2 iterates over all fragments and for each one calls duplicate?/2, which evaluates Enum.count(fragments, &(&1.name == name)) — a full linear scan of the fragment list. The result is O(N²) comparisons per document, where N is the number of fragment definitions supplied by the caller.

Because input.fragments is built directly from the GraphQL query body, N is fully attacker-controlled. A minimum-size fragment definition is roughly 16 bytes, so a ~1 MB document carries ~60,000 fragments and forces ~3.6 × 10⁹ comparisons inside this single validation phase. No authentication, schema knowledge, or special configuration is required.

This issue affects absinthe: from 1.2.0 before 1.10.2.

Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows HTTP request smuggling via duplicate Content-Length headers.

Bandit.Headers.get_content_length/1 in lib/bandit/headers.ex uses List.keyfind/3, which returns only the first matching header. When a request contains two Content-Length headers with different values, Bandit silently accepts it, uses the first value to read the body, and dispatches the remaining bytes as a second pipelined request on the same keep-alive connection. RFC 9112 §6.3 requires recipients to treat this as an unrecoverable framing error.

When Bandit sits behind a proxy that picks the last Content-Length value and forwards the request rather than rejecting it, an unauthenticated attacker can smuggle requests past edge WAF rules, path-based ACLs, rate limiting, and audit logging.

This issue affects bandit: from 0.1.0 before 1.11.0.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows unauthenticated remote denial of service via memory exhaustion when WebSocket permessage-deflate compression is enabled.

Bandit.WebSocket.PerMessageDeflate.inflate/2 in lib/bandit/websocket/permessage_deflate.ex calls :zlib.inflate/2 with no output-size cap, then materializes the entire decompressed payload as a single binary via IO.iodata_to_binary/1. The websocket_options.max_frame_size option only bounds the on-the-wire (compressed) frame size, not the decompressed output. A high-ratio compressed frame (e.g. uniform data at ~1024:1 ratio) can stay well under any wire-size limit while forcing GiB-scale heap allocations in the connection process before any application code runs.

An unauthenticated attacker who can open a WebSocket connection can send a single such frame to exhaust the BEAM node's memory and trigger an OOM kill.

This vulnerability requires both Bandit's server-level websocket_options.compress and the per-upgrade compress: true option passed to WebSockAdapter.upgrade/4 to be enabled. Stock Phoenix and LiveView applications are not affected as they default to compress: false.

This issue affects bandit: from 0.5.9 before 1.11.0.

Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows unauthenticated transport-state spoofing on plaintext HTTP connections.

Bandit.Pipeline.determine_scheme/2 in lib/bandit/pipeline.ex returns the client-supplied URI scheme verbatim, ignoring the transport's secure? flag. HTTP/1.1 absolute-form request targets (e.g. GET https://victim/path HTTP/1.1) and the HTTP/2 :scheme pseudo-header are both attacker-controlled strings that flow through this function. Over a plaintext TCP connection, a client can declare https and Bandit will set conn.scheme = :https even though no TLS was negotiated.

Downstream Plug consumers that branch on conn.scheme are silently misled: Plug.SSL's already-secure branch skips its HTTP→HTTPS redirect, cookies emitted with secure: true are sent over plaintext, audit logs record requests as having arrived over HTTPS, and CSRF/SameSite gating may make incorrect decisions.

This issue affects bandit: from 1.0.0-pre.6 before 1.11.0.

A flaw was found in crun. When copying files onto a tmpfs mounted with tmpcopyup, crun opens the destination a second time by name. A container that shares a writable volume with the container being created can change that path between the two lookups, so crun copies image files onto host files, including files under /proc/sys.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

inet: reject unhashed sockets during established lookups

TCP established ehash lookups are lockless. The socket caches involved
use SLAB_TYPESAFE_BY_RCU, so memory can be reused before an RCU reader
that retained its old address has finished.

After a tuple match, __inet_lookup_established() and
__inet6_lookup_established() acquire a reference and repeat the tuple
check. They do not check whether the new object is hashed. If the
address is reused for a socket with the same tuple, the lookup can
acquire a reference to the new object and return it while its nulls node
is unhashed.

A PoC that drives reuse with a SYN cookie request socket reproduced the
crash. The new request socket is unhashed and has a NULL rsk_listener.
A lookup that had loaded the address of the old request socket acquired
the reference published by tcp_get_cookie_sock() and returned the new
object. tcp_v4_rcv() then read sk_state through the NULL listener.

The resulting crash was:

  BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference, address: 0000000000000012
  #PF: supervisor read access in kernel mode
  #PF: error_code(0x0000) - not-present page
  ...
  Oops: Oops: 0000 [#1] SMP NOPTI
  CPU: 4 UID: 0 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/4 Not tainted 7.3.0-00591-g0e135910deec #1 PREEMPT(lazy)
  ...
  RIP: 0010:tcp_v4_rcv+0x44e/0x1280
  ...
  R10: 0000000000000001 R11: 00000000024ca8c0 R12: 0000000000000000
  ...
  CR2: 0000000000000012 CR3: 0000000103d50004 CR4: 0000000000770ef0
  ...

After taking a reference, check whether the nulls node is unhashed in
both IPv4 and IPv6 established lookups. If it is unhashed or the tuple
no longer matches, drop the reference and restart the lookup.

Lookups racing with the TIME_WAIT hashdance, or with a request being
replaced by its child, now restart and find the new socket instead of
returning the old one.

Request sockets that were never inserted into ehash can have a nonzero
refcount, and a stale lookup can hold a transient reference. Therefore,
when SYN cookie, Fast Open, and request migration paths fail after
setting a nonzero refcount, release the references held by those paths
with reqsk_put() instead of freeing the request directly.

Electrum before 4.8.3 fails to verify signatures of wallet-owned inputs in unconfirmed mempool transactions, allowing malicious servers to replace a just-broadcast transaction with a conflicting one. Attackers can swallow the user's transaction and display an invalid zero-fee copy paying an attacker address, tricking users into RBF fee-bumping and signing it.

A flaw was found in gst-plugins-base. A heap buffer overflow can be triggered when processing video buffers whose attached GstVideoMeta metadata declares plane strides and offsets that exceed the actual backing memory allocation. The metadata is not range-checked during deserialization, and the video frame mapping code does not verify that the declared plane geometry fits within the buffer before allowing consumers to read or write video data. A local attacker who controls the sending side of a GStreamer inter-process IPC pipeline can deliver a crafted buffer carrying fabricated strides, causing the receiving process to read or write beyond heap boundaries. Successful exploitation can cause a denial of service or potentially allow code execution within the affected process.

cves.d:
Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows unauthenticated remote denial of service via memory exhaustion.

The fragment reassembly path in Bandit.WebSocket.Connection.handle_frame/3 in lib/bandit/websocket/connection.ex appends every incoming Continuation{fin: false} frame's payload to a per-connection iolist with no cumulative size cap. The existing max_frame_size option only bounds individual frames; a peer that streams an unbounded number of continuation frames without ever setting fin=1 grows BEAM heap linearly until the OS or a supervisor kills the process.

Because the accumulation happens before WebSock.handle_in/2 is called, the application has no opportunity to interpose a size check. Phoenix Channels and LiveView both run over WebSock on Bandit, so a stock Phoenix application exposes this surface as soon as it accepts socket connections.

This issue affects bandit: from 0.5.1 before 1.11.0.

A flaw has been found in hrshadhin CloudSchool up to 3.0.1. Affected by this issue is the function PublicController.checkSanity4Student of the file app/Http/Controllers/Backend/PublicController.php of the component Student Data Access Check. This manipulation of the argument student_id causes authorization bypass. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows unauthenticated memory exhaustion via oversized HTTP/2 frames.

Bandit.HTTP2.Frame.deserialize/2 in lib/bandit/http2/frame.ex checks the SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE limit only after pattern-matching payload::binary-size(length), which requires the entire frame body to be present in memory before either the accept or reject clause can fire. A peer that announces a frame length up to the 24-bit maximum (~16 MiB) causes the server to buffer that entire body before the size guard is evaluated, regardless of the max_frame_size negotiated during the HTTP/2 handshake (default 16 KiB per RFC 9113).

An unauthenticated attacker holding many concurrent connections can force the server to buffer far more memory than the negotiated frame size limit should permit, leading to memory pressure and potential denial of service.

This issue affects bandit: from 0.3.6 before 1.11.0.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in gleam-wisp wisp allows a denial of service via multipart form body parsing.

The multipart_body function bypasses configured max_body_size and max_files_size limits. When a multipart boundary is not present in a chunk, the parser takes the MoreRequiredForBody path, which appends the chunk to the output but passes the quota unchanged to the recursive call. Only the final chunk containing the boundary is counted via decrement_quota. The same pattern exists in multipart_headers, where MoreRequiredForHeaders recurses without calling decrement_body_quota.

An unauthenticated attacker can exhaust server memory or disk by sending arbitrarily large multipart form submissions in a single HTTP request.

This issue affects wisp: from 0.2.0 before 2.2.2.

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in hexpm hexpm/hexpm (HexpmWeb.API.OAuthController module) allows Privilege Escalation.

An API key created with read-only permissions (domain: "api", resource: "read") can be escalated to full write access under specific conditions.

When exchanging a read-only API key via the OAuth client_credentials grant, the resource qualifier is ignored. The resulting JWT receives the broad "api" scope instead of the expected "api:read" scope. This token is therefore treated as having full API access.

If an attacker is able to obtain a victim's read-only API key and a valid 2FA (TOTP) code for the victim account, they can use the incorrectly scoped JWT to create a new full-access API key with unrestricted API permissions that does not expire by default and can perform write operations such as publishing, retiring, or modifying packages.

This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/hexpm_web/controllers/api/oauth_controller.ex and program routines HexpmWeb.API.OAuthController.validate_scopes_against_key/2.

This issue affects hex.pm: from 2025-08-18 before 2026-03-05; hexpm/hexpm: from 71829cb6f6559bcceb1ef4e43a2fb8cdd3af654b before 71c127afebb7ed7cc637eb231b98feb802d62999.

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in hexpm hexpm/hexpm (Hexpm.Accounts.PasswordReset module) allows Account Takeover.

Password reset tokens generated via the "Reset your password" flow do not expire. When a user requests a password reset, Hex sends an email containing a reset link with a token. This token remains valid indefinitely until used. There is no time-based expiration enforced.

If a user's historical emails are exposed through a data breach (e.g., a leaked mailbox archive), any unused password reset email contained in that dataset could be used by an attacker to reset the victim's password. The attacker does not need current access to the victim's email account, only access to a previously leaked copy of the reset email.

This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/hexpm/accounts/password_reset.ex and program routines Hexpm.Accounts.PasswordReset.can_reset?/3.

This issue affects hex.pm: from 2025-08-01 before 2026-03-05; hexpm/hexpm: from 617e44c71f1dd9043870205f371d375c5c4d886d before bb0e42091995945deef10556f58d046a52eb7884.

cves.d:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in hexpm hexpm/hexpm (Hexpm.Store.Local module) allows Relative Path Traversal.

This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/hexpm/store/local.ex and program routines Hexpm.Store.Local.get/3, Hexpm.Store.Local.put/4, Hexpm.Store.Local.delete/2, Hexpm.Store.Local.delete_many/2.

This issue does NOT affect hex.pm the service. Only self-hosted deployments using the Local Storage backend are affected.

This issue affects hexpm/hexpm: from 931ee0ed46fa89218e0400a4f6e6d15f96406050 before 5d2ccd2f14f45a63225a73fb5b1c937baf36fdc0.

Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability in mtrudel bandit allows unauthenticated remote denial of service via worker process exhaustion.

Bandit.HTTP1.Socket.do_read_chunked_data!/5 in lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex terminates only when the last-chunk line 0\r\n is followed immediately by the empty trailer line \r\n. RFC 9112 §7.1.2 permits zero or more trailer fields between them. When trailers are present, none of the match clauses fit: the catch-all arm computes a negative to_read, calls read_available!/2, receives <<>> on timeout, and tail-recurses with unchanged state. The worker process is pinned for the lifetime of the TCP connection.

A handful of concurrent connections sending RFC-conformant chunked requests with trailer fields is sufficient to exhaust the Bandit worker pool and render the server unresponsive to all further traffic. No authentication, special headers, or large payload is required. Proxies such as NGINX and HAProxy legitimately forward trailer-bearing requests, so servers behind such proxies may be affected without any malicious client involvement.

This issue affects bandit: from 1.6.1 before 1.11.1.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in elixir-plug plug_cowboy allows unauthenticated remote denial of service via atom table exhaustion.

Plug.Cowboy.Conn.conn/1 in lib/plug/cowboy/conn.ex calls String.to_atom/1 on the value returned by :cowboy_req.scheme/1. For HTTP/2 connections, cowlib passes the client-supplied :scheme pseudo-header value through verbatim without validation. Each unique value permanently allocates a new entry in the BEAM atom table. Since atoms are never garbage-collected and the atom table has a fixed limit (default 1,048,576), an unauthenticated attacker can exhaust the table by sending HTTP/2 requests with unique :scheme values, causing the Erlang VM to abort with system_limit and taking down the entire node.

This vulnerability does not affect HTTP/1.1, where cowboy derives the scheme from the listener type rather than from a client-supplied header.

This issue affects plug_cowboy: from 2.0.0 before 2.8.1.

A vulnerability has been found in sumiie24 School-Management-System up to d946d649c7c95e101fc5679ecd91999533bb10d7. The affected element is an unknown function of the file parent_Registration.php. Such manipulation of the argument student_reg leads to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. When a client application enforces step-up authentication or multi-factor authentication (MFA) via a minimum authentication level, Keycloak fails to apply this requirement to login sessions initiated through the credential reset endpoint. An attacker who possesses a user's initial credentials (such as a password) can navigate from the reset interface back to the standard login form and authenticate without completing the required second factor. This flaw allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected services without satisfying mandatory security controls.

BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in ext4_fs_init_inode_bitmap() in src/ext4_fs.c because it does not validate s_inodes_per_group against the inode bitmap size. Attackers can supply a crafted ext4 image with an oversized s_inodes_per_group so memset writes past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing the mounting application.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is characterized by a high concentration of remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws targeting critical network infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise software, with several actively exploited threats posing immediate risk. Prominent vendors such as VMware, F5, Cisco, and PHP are central to these findings, which include dangerous hypervisor escapes, container breakout capabilities, and supply chain compromises affecting development pipelines like GitHub Actions and JetBrains TeamCity. The pervasive nature of memory corruption bugs, injection attacks, and insecure configurations across desktop, IoT, and industrial control systems demands urgent remediation to prevent unauthorized system access and operational disruption.
ai.summary_zh: 当前漏洞态势以针对关键网络基础设施、云平台和企业软件的远程代码执行与身份验证绕过缺陷高度集中为特征，多项遭活跃利用的威胁已构成直接风险。VMware、F5、Cisco 和 PHP 等主流厂商位列受影响核心，相关漏洞涵盖危险的 Hypervisor 逃逸、容器突破能力及影响 GitHub Actions 和 JetBrains TeamCity 等开发流水线的供应链攻击。鉴于内存破坏类漏洞、注入攻击与不安全配置在桌面端、物联网设备及工业控制系统中广泛存在，必须采取紧急修复措施，以防遭受未授权访问及业务中断。

items.reason_en: Microsoft Word heap overflow allows unauthenticated network-based remote code execution, posing a severe threat to end-users opening malicious documents.

items.reason_en: Krita's file parsing flaw enables remote code execution when users open crafted image files, directly compromising desktop workstations.

items.reason_en: Clipboard buffer overflow in RustDesk allows remote code execution on Windows clients during peer sessions. This poses a critical threat to remote desktop infrastructure and user endpoints.
items.reason_zh: RustDesk 剪贴板缓冲区溢出漏洞可在对等会话期间导致 Windows 客户端发生远程代码执行。这对远程桌面基础设施和用户终端构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in FreeRDP enables code execution when connecting to malicious RDP servers. Enterprises relying on remote desktop protocols must patch immediately to prevent compromise.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP 堆越界写入漏洞在连接恶意 RDP 服务器时可触发代码执行。依赖远程桌面协议的企业必须立即修补以防止系统被攻破。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in SiYuan's Electron renderer executes JavaScript with full Node.js access, enabling potential remote code execution and credential theft.
items.reason_zh: SiYuan 的 Electron 渲染器中存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，可执行具有完整 Node.js 访问权限的 JavaScript 代码，可能导致远程代码执行和凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Local command injection in rpmuncompress allows arbitrary command execution when processing archive filenames containing shell metacharacters.
items.reason_zh: rpmuncompress 存在本地命令注入漏洞，在处理包含 Shell 元字符的归档文件名时可执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in GIMP's PSD image resource loader can trigger arbitrary code execution when opening maliciously crafted design files.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PSD 图像资源加载器存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，打开恶意构造的设计文件时可触发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal during Flatpak app deployment allows malicious packages to overwrite or symlink critical host system files like passwd or resolv.conf.
items.reason_zh: Flatpak 应用部署过程中的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意软件包覆盖或创建符号链接至 passwd 或 resolv.conf 等关键主机系统文件。

items.reason_en: Vim's netrw plugin allows arbitrary code execution via crafted filenames, posing a direct threat to developers and sysadmins who process untrusted files.
items.reason_zh: Vim 的 netrw 插件可通过构造的文件名实现任意代码执行，对处理不受信任文件的开发人员和系统管理员构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: cifs-utils fails to sanitize credentials before assembling mount commands, enabling unprivileged local users to escalate privileges to root.
items.reason_zh: cifs-utils 在组装挂载命令前未能清理凭据，使本地非特权用户能够提权至 root。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Linux kernel's Logitech HID++ driver can corrupt memory and potentially lead to local privilege escalation or system instability.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核的 Logitech HID++ 驱动中存在竞态条件漏洞，可能导致内存损坏，进而引发本地权限提升或系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Incorrect default permissions in ASUS DisplayWidget allow local privilege escalation via crafted executables placed in user-writable directories.
items.reason_zh: ASUS DisplayWidget 的默认权限配置错误，攻击者通过将构造的可执行文件放置于用户可写目录中可实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Broken cryptographic signature verification in Dell AWCC enables arbitrary code execution and elevation of privilege for low-privilege users.
items.reason_zh: Dell AWCC 的加密签名验证机制存在缺陷，可导致任意代码执行及低权限用户的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Code execution via Code Provenance plugin in IntelliJ IDEA compromises developer workstations using untrusted or malicious projects.
items.reason_zh: IntelliJ IDEA 的 Code Provenance 插件可导致代码执行，危及使用不受信任或恶意项目的开发人员工作站。

items.reason_en: JIT sandbox escape in BeamNG.drive allows malicious Lua mods to execute arbitrary code outside the game environment via missing FFI bounds checks.
items.reason_zh: BeamNG.drive 的 JIT 沙箱逃逸漏洞使恶意 Lua 模组因缺少 FFI 边界检查而在游戏环境外执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write triggered by malicious SBSAR files in Autodesk 3ds Max can lead to application crash or remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Autodesk 3ds Max 中由恶意 SBSAR 文件触发的越界写入漏洞可导致应用程序崩溃或远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: D-Link smart camera suffers from remote command injection via its CGI interface, allowing attackers to fully compromise connected IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 智能摄像头通过其 CGI 接口存在远程命令注入漏洞，攻击者可借此完全控制连接的物联网设备。

items.reason_en: TP-Link Tapo cameras exhibit improper authentication that lets local network attackers bypass login controls and steal administrative session tokens.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo 摄像头存在认证缺陷，允许局域网攻击者绕过登录控制并窃取管理员会话令牌。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated BLE command injection on electric brake systems allows attackers to directly influence braking mechanisms without pairing or authentication.
items.reason_zh: 电动制动系统上的未授权 BLE 命令注入漏洞允许攻击者在无需配对或认证的情况下直接影响制动机制。

items.reason_en: Critical braking control interfaces lack command-integrity protection and sequence numbers, enabling remote attackers to replay captured commands and override safety protocols.
items.reason_zh: 关键制动控制接口缺乏命令完整性保护和序列号机制，使远程攻击者能够重放捕获的命令并覆盖安全协议。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds write in SmartLock's WireGuard-Lwip X25519 implementation can be triggered remotely, potentially compromising cryptographic operations and device security.
items.reason_zh: SmartLock 的 WireGuard-Lwip X25519 实现中存在可远程触发的越界写入漏洞，可能破坏密码学操作及设备安全。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Gladys Assistant's backup handler allows remote attackers to read or modify sensitive system files. This directly compromises home automation hub integrity and user privacy.
items.reason_zh: Gladys Assistant 的备份处理器存在路径遍历漏洞，允许远程攻击者读取或修改敏感系统文件。这直接破坏了家庭自动化网关的完整性及用户隐私。

items.reason_en: MQTT broker state retention flaw in aMQTT can lead to transaction desynchronization and resource exhaustion. IoT deployments using QoS 2 messaging may experience disrupted device communications.
items.reason_zh: aMQTT 的 MQTT 代理状态保留缺陷可能导致事务不同步和资源耗尽。使用 QoS 2 消息传递的物联网部署可能会出现设备通信中断。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated file disclosure on NUUO NVRmini surveillance devices exposes hardcoded credentials and PHP source code confined to the document root.
items.reason_zh: NUUO NVRmini 监控设备存在未授权的文件泄露漏洞，暴露了限制在文档根目录内的硬编码凭据和 PHP 源代码。

items.reason_en: SoftBank Air Terminal 6 suffers from OS command injection, allowing root-level remote code execution over wired or Wi-Fi connections.
items.reason_zh: SoftBank Air Terminal 6 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许通过有线或 Wi-Fi 连接以 root 权限执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Gladys Assistant's backup restore endpoint is vulnerable to OS command injection, threatening home automation setups with full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Gladys Assistant 的备份还原端点易受操作系统命令注入攻击，可能导致家庭自动化系统被完全攻破。

items.reason_en: Nerves Hub lacks proper authorization checks in bulk device actions, enabling cross-organization device control and potential IoT fleet hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Nerves Hub 在批量设备操作中缺乏适当的授权检查，导致跨组织设备控制及潜在的物联网车队劫持风险。

items.reason_en: VMware vCenter Directory Service contains a critical authentication bypass actively exploited in the wild, risking complete hypervisor and cloud infrastructure control.
items.reason_zh: VMware vCenter Directory Service 存在一个已在真实环境中被积极利用的关键身份验证绕过漏洞，可能导致虚拟机管理程序和云基础设施被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Quay's SQL injection flaw allows attackers to extract sensitive robot account credentials and compromise container registry integrity.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Quay 的 SQL 注入漏洞使攻击者能够提取敏感的机器人账户凭据，并破坏容器注册表的完整性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaws in Google Cloud Dataform and BigQuery Studio allow authenticated attackers to read private files and create arbitrary files across tenant repositories.
items.reason_zh: Google Cloud Dataform 和 BigQuery Studio 中的路径遍历漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者在租户存储库中读取私有文件并创建任意文件。

items.reason_en: GitHub Actions workflows utilizing pull_request_target execute untrusted fork code, creating a severe supply chain risk by running attacker-controlled scripts in the base repository context.
items.reason_zh: 使用 pull_request_target 的 GitHub Actions 工作流会执行不受信任的分支代码，在基础仓库上下文中运行攻击者控制的脚本，从而造成严重的供应链风险。

items.reason_en: VM escape vulnerability in NVIDIA Bluefield-3 Virtio-Net enables guest-to-host code execution via crafted messages. Cloud providers and virtualized environments face severe tenant isolation breaches.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA Bluefield-3 Virtio-Net 中的虚拟机逃逸漏洞可通过构造的消息实现客户机到主机的代码执行。云提供商和虚拟化环境面临严重的租户隔离破坏风险。

items.reason_en: Okta .NET SDK fails to restrict outbound requests to the configured organization domain, leaking SSWS API tokens to external hosts. Identity management integrations are at high risk of credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Okta .NET SDK 未将出站请求限制在配置的组织域内，导致 SSWS API 令牌泄露至外部主机。身份管理集成面临极高的凭证窃取风险。

items.reason_en: Traefik's Kubernetes ingress provider mishandles conflicting TLS and authentication annotations, potentially bypassing access controls. Multi-tenant cloud architectures could suffer unauthorized backend access.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 Kubernetes Ingress 提供程序错误处理冲突的 TLS 和认证注解，可能导致访问控制被绕过。多租户云架构可能遭受未经授权的后台访问。

items.reason_en: Flaw in Red Hat Kuadrant's WASM shim bypasses token rate limits when attached alongside authentication policies, risking API gateway abuse and resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Kuadrant 的 WASM 存根存在缺陷，在与认证策略配合使用时会绕过令牌速率限制，导致 API 网关滥用和资源耗尽风险。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform exposes unauthenticated debug views that trigger internal schedulers, risking unauthorized workflow execution.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 暴露了无需身份验证即可访问的调试视图，这些视图会触发内部调度器，存在未经授权的工作流执行风险。

items.reason_en: ExAws.SNS fails to properly validate certificates, allowing signature spoofing against AWS SNS services and compromising cloud message integrity.
items.reason_zh: ExAws.SNS 未能正确验证证书，允许对 AWS SNS 服务进行签名伪造，从而破坏云消息的完整性。

items.reason_en: Hex.pm's OAuth token endpoint misinterprets scopes, allowing repository-permissioned API keys to read private packages across organizations.
items.reason_zh: Hex.pm 的 OAuth 令牌端点错误解析作用域（scopes），使得具有仓库权限的 API 密钥能够跨组织读取私有软件包。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in VMware SDDC Manager allows unauthorized manipulation of core cloud infrastructure configurations.
items.reason_zh: VMware SDDC Manager 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许未经授权地篡改核心云基础设施配置。

items.reason_en: Authenticated command injection in SDDC Manager enables complete control over virtual data center operations.
items.reason_zh: SDDC Manager 中的已认证命令注入漏洞使攻击者能够完全控制虚拟数据中心的操作。

items.reason_en: Container escape vulnerability in crun allows malicious containers to overwrite host files via improperly handled tmpfs mounts.
items.reason_zh: crun 中的容器逃逸漏洞允许恶意容器通过处理不当的 tmpfs 挂载覆盖主机文件。

items.reason_en: Cisco Expressway Series suffers from unauthenticated remote code execution via its database service, already tracked in CISA KEV for active exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Expressway Series 的数据库服务存在无需身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞，该漏洞已被 CISA KEV 收录并遭活跃利用。

items.reason_en: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST API allows authenticated managers to inject configuration objects that execute arbitrary system commands, impacting network perimeter security.
items.reason_zh: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST API 允许经过身份验证的管理员注入可执行任意系统命令的配置对象，影响网络边界安全。

items.reason_en: A publicly exploited OS command injection in D-Link DIR-600L routers via the GENA CGI handler allows remote attackers to fully compromise network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 通过 GENA CGI 处理程序在 D-Link DIR-600L 路由器中存在公开利用的系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者完全接管网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Netatalk's DHX2/PAM authentication state machine permits session reuse after credential release, potentially bypassing access controls on legacy Apple Filing Protocol servers.
items.reason_zh: Netatalk 的 DHX2/PAM 认证状态机允许在凭证释放后重用会话，可能绕过传统 Apple Filing Protocol 服务器的访问控制。

items.reason_en: Net::DNS relies on Perl's weak built-in rand() for 16-bit query IDs, enabling network attackers to predict identifiers and spoof DNS responses effectively.
items.reason_zh: Net::DNS 依赖 Perl 脆弱的内置 rand() 函数生成 16 位查询 ID，使网络攻击者能够预测标识符并有效伪造 DNS 响应。

items.reason_en: Traefik's digestAuth middleware incorrectly accepts empty secrets for unknown usernames, enabling complete authentication bypass. Reverse proxy deployments remain vulnerable to unauthorized traffic routing.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 digestAuth 中间件错误地接受未知用户名的空密钥，导致完整的身份验证绕过。反向代理部署仍易受未经授权的流量路由影响。

items.reason_en: OpenWrt LuCI misconfigures RPCD ACLs, granting file execution permissions to read-only users. Router administrators can escalate privileges to execute state-mutating commands.
items.reason_zh: OpenWrt LuCI 错误配置了 RPCD ACL，向只读用户授予了文件执行权限。路由器管理员可利用此漏洞提升权限以执行更改状态的命令。

items.reason_en: Hickory DNS recursive resolver mishandles cyclic sibling referrals, creating query amplification vectors. Network operators face increased risk of DNS reflection attacks.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS 递归解析器错误处理循环兄弟节点转发，创建了查询放大向量。网络运营商面临更高的 DNS 反射攻击风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 worker process use-after-free in F5 NGINX can lead to remote code execution when proxying requests with variable server names under specific configurations.
items.reason_zh: 特定配置下，F5 NGINX 在处理带有可变服务器名称的请求时，其 HTTP/2 工作进程的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 flow control window threshold breach causes a heap buffer overflow in F5 NGINX, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution or service crash.
items.reason_zh: HTTP/2 流量控制窗口阈值突破会导致 F5 NGINX 发生堆缓冲区溢出，可能导致任意代码执行或服务崩溃。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Traefik's Kubernetes Ingress provider misnames TLS options, allowing two separate Ingress objects to share credentials and bypass mutual TLS enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 Kubernetes Ingress 提供程序因错误命名 TLS 选项导致身份验证绕过，允许两个独立的 Ingress 对象共享凭据并绕过双向 TLS 强制实施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Ettercap's PCRE filter module enables memory corruption and potential code execution when processing packets matching loaded regex substitution filters.
items.reason_zh: Ettercap 的 PCRE 过滤模块存在释放后使用漏洞，在处理匹配已加载正则表达式替换过滤器的数据包时，可导致内存损坏及潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Red Hat sos clean utility contains a path traversal flaw during tar extraction, allowing local attackers to overwrite arbitrary files on network infrastructure systems.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat sos clean 工具在 tar 解压过程中存在路径遍历缺陷，允许本地攻击者覆盖网络基础设施系统中的任意文件。

items.reason_en: Erlang/OTP's distribution-over-TLS LAN allowlist relies solely on IP addresses, enabling unauthenticated bypass if IP spoofing occurs.
items.reason_zh: Erlang/OTP 的基于 TLS 的分布式 LAN 白名单仅依赖 IP 地址，若发生 IP 欺骗则可实现无需身份验证的绕过。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Dell PowerStore SDNAS permits unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise storage appliances.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore SDNAS 中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在企业存储设备上实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in PowerStore allows unauthenticated attackers to read, modify, or delete critical NAS configuration files.
items.reason_zh: PowerStore 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者读取、修改或删除关键的 NAS 配置文件。

items.reason_en: HTTP request smuggling in SQUID proxies bypasses frontend security controls and traditional firewall inspection rules.
items.reason_zh: SQUID 代理中的 HTTP 请求走私漏洞可绕过前端安全控制和传统防火墙检测规则。

items.reason_en: Fixes a race condition in Linux TCP socket lookups that could lead to memory corruption or unexpected connection drops.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 Linux TCP 套接字查找中的竞争条件，该问题可能导致内存损坏或意外连接中断。

items.reason_en: Open Robotics RViz contains a heap-based buffer overflow enabling remote code execution without authentication, threatening robotics and automation deployments.
items.reason_zh: Open Robotics RViz 存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致无需认证的远程代码执行，威胁机器人与自动化部署环境。

items.reason_en: NASA AIT GUI framework writes attacker-controlled telemetry data to configuration files without proper sanitization, risking integrity and safety of real-time mission operations systems.
items.reason_zh: NASA AIT GUI 框架在未进行适当清理的情况下将攻击者控制的遥测数据写入配置文件，危及实时任务操作系统的完整性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Danfoss legacy controllers ship with default credentials documented in manuals, allowing immediate unauthorized access. Operational technology environments risk unmonitored control over critical infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Danfoss 旧版控制器随附手册中记录的默认凭据，导致立即遭受未授权访问。运营技术环境面临关键基础设施控制权失控的风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated buffer overflow in Moxa Ethernet Remote I/O SNMP service triggers denial-of-service conditions. Industrial monitoring systems become unavailable to network administrators.
items.reason_zh: Moxa Ethernet Remote I/O SNMP 服务中存在无需认证的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可触发拒绝服务状态，导致网络管理员无法访问工业监控系统。

items.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in an unauthenticated CGI handler of the Danfoss AK-SM controller enables memory corruption and potential arbitrary code execution with webserver privileges.
items.reason_zh: Danfoss AK-SM 控制器的未认证 CGI 处理器存在远程栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致内存破坏及以 Web 服务器权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Apache Roller's unauthenticated deserialization flaw permits remote code execution and is currently exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller 存在无需认证的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，且该漏洞目前已在野外被实际利用。

items.reason_en: Tribulant Software Newsletters plugin suffers from object injection leading to RCE, highlighting ongoing risks in popular WordPress ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Tribulant Software Newsletters 插件存在导致远程代码执行的对象注入漏洞，凸显了流行 WordPress 生态系统中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: U.S. Department of the Interior web application contains a critical SQL injection flaw granting unauthenticated attackers root-level database control.
items.reason_zh: 美国内政部 Web 应用程序存在严重的 SQL 注入漏洞，可使未授权攻击者获得数据库的 root 级控制权。

items.reason_en: Flowintel disables TLS certificate verification for MISP and mail connections, enabling man-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate remote servers and intercept sensitive communications.
items.reason_zh: Flowintel 针对 MISP 和邮件连接禁用了 TLS 证书验证，使中间人攻击者能够伪装远程服务器并拦截敏感通信。

items.reason_en: The miniOrange OTP verification WordPress plugin suffers from an authentication bypass, allowing unauthorized actors to gain full access to protected user accounts.
items.reason_zh: miniOrange OTP verification WordPress 插件存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未授权主体完全访问受保护的用户账户。

items.reason_en: NukeViet CMS SVG upload validation fails to expand internal DTD entities, allowing attackers to hide script tags and trigger critical stored XSS in vulnerable web applications.
items.reason_zh: NukeViet CMS 的 SVG 上传验证未能展开内部 DTD 实体，攻击者可借此隐藏脚本标签并在易受攻击的 Web 应用中触发严重的存储型 XSS。

items.reason_en: XOneManager's publication workflow incorrectly accepts update requests from read-only project members, enabling unauthorized content modifications and potential data tampering.
items.reason_zh: XOneManager 的发布工作流错误地接受来自只读项目成员的更新请求，导致未经授权的內容修改及潜在的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: @fastify/reply-from mishandles body forwarding for stateless HTTP methods like GET and HEAD, which can cause upstream connection failures or bypass security filters.
items.reason_zh: @fastify/reply-from 在处理 GET 和 HEAD 等无状态 HTTP 方法的请求体转发时存在缺陷，可能导致上游连接失败或绕过安全过滤器。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload in Tegsoft Contact Center permits direct web shell deployment. Attackers gain full server control and can pivot to internal networks.
items.reason_zh: Tegsoft Contact Center 存在不受限制的文件上传漏洞，允许直接部署 Web Shell。攻击者可获得服务器完全控制权并横向移动至内部网络。

items.reason_en: Poste.io DMARC report processing executes unsafe shell commands on root, enabling remote code execution via crafted attachments. Mail server infrastructure faces critical compromise risks.
items.reason_zh: Poste.io 的 DMARC 报告处理以 root 权限执行不安全的 Shell 命令，可通过构造的附件实现远程代码执行，邮件服务器基础设施面临严重失陷风险。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in pretix-adyen allows attackers to redirect payment API calls to malicious servers. E-commerce platforms processing ticket sales risk financial fraud and data interception.
items.reason_zh: pretix-adyen 存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，攻击者可重定向支付 API 调用至恶意服务器。处理票务销售的电商平台面临金融欺诈与数据拦截风险。

items.reason_en: Calculation field formulas in Joomla Visforms execute via PHP eval() without validation, allowing backend users with edit permissions to inject arbitrary PHP code.
items.reason_zh: Joomla Visforms 的计算字段公式通过 PHP eval() 执行且缺乏验证，允许具有编辑权限的后端用户注入任意 PHP 代码。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Etherpad's pre-authentication asset handler bypasses POSIX checks via backslash conversion, enabling remote code execution on Linux servers.
items.reason_zh: Etherpad 的预认证资源处理器存在路径遍历漏洞，可通过反斜杠转换绕过 POSIX 检查，从而在 Linux 服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Insufficient sanitization of Universal Search Filters in Dolibarr strips only a single table prefix, allowing attackers to bypass denylists and perform account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr 的通用搜索过滤器清理不足，仅剥离单个表前缀，攻击者可借此绕过黑名单并实施账户接管。

items.reason_en: Scoped API keys in Grav's admin plugin bypass declared scope restrictions on privileged endpoints, granting unauthorized administrative access to lower-privilege tokens.
items.reason_zh: Grav 管理插件中的作用域受限 API 密钥可绕过特权端点的声明作用域限制，使低权限令牌获得未授权的访问权限。

items.reason_en: Phoenix Storybook allows unauthenticated RCE via HEEx template injection in its playground WebSocket, directly impacting web application development environments.
items.reason_zh: Phoenix Storybook 允许通过其 Playground WebSocket 中的 HEEx 模板注入实现无需认证的远程代码执行，直接影响 Web 应用开发环境。

items.reason_en: AshAuthentication matches local users by email during OAuth/OIDC sign-in, enabling straightforward account takeover via email spoofing.
items.reason_zh: AshAuthentication 在 OAuth/OIDC 登录期间通过电子邮件匹配本地用户，使得通过电子邮件伪造即可轻易实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: Dropbox Samly accepts captured SAML assertions without duplicate detection, allowing replay attacks to authenticate as any user.
items.reason_zh: Dropbox Samly 在未进行重复检测的情况下接受捕获的 SAML 断言，允许重放攻击冒充任何用户进行身份验证。

items.reason_en: Erlang/OTP SSL completes TLS 1.3 handshakes without validating offered PSK extensions, allowing peer impersonation of intended servers.
items.reason_zh: Erlang/OTP SSL 在完成 TLS 1.3 握手时未验证提供的 PSK 扩展，允许对等方伪装目标服务器。

items.reason_en: Hackney converts unrecognized URL schemes to permanent BEAM atoms, causing irreversible atom table exhaustion and service crashes.
items.reason_zh: Hackney 会将无法识别的 URL 方案转换为永久 BEAM 原子，导致不可逆的原子表耗尽及服务崩溃。

items.reason_en: Critical authenticated RCE in Splunk SOAR via the App Wizard allows full system compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Splunk SOAR 的应用向导存在严重的已认证远程代码执行漏洞，可导致系统完全失陷及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Session serializer mismatch enables remote code execution with a high EPSS score indicating significant exploitation risk.
items.reason_zh: 会话序列化器不匹配可导致远程代码执行，其高 EPSS 评分表明存在显著的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE via external pull requests severely impacts CI/CD pipeline integrity and developer workflows.
items.reason_zh: 通过外部拉取请求实现的无需认证远程代码执行严重破坏了 CI/CD 流水线的完整性及开发者工作流程。

items.reason_en: Non-expiring password reset tokens in Hexpm lead to straightforward account takeover without additional authentication factors.
items.reason_zh: Hexpm 中永不过期的密码重置令牌会导致无需额外认证因素即可轻易实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: Remote SQL injection in the student registration module exposes sensitive educational data and user credentials.
items.reason_zh: 学生注册模块中的远程 SQL 注入漏洞会泄露敏感的教育数据及用户凭据。

items.reason_en: Splunk Enterprise allows unauthenticated users to read and modify clustering configurations using an empty shared secret, disrupting log aggregation integrity.
items.reason_zh: Splunk Enterprise 允许未认证用户使用空共享密钥读取和修改集群配置，破坏日志聚合的完整性。

items.reason_en: Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology exposes an easily exploitable vulnerability over T3/IIOP protocols, compromising enterprise middleware security.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology 在 T3/IIOP 协议上存在易被利用的漏洞，危及企业中间件安全。

items.reason_en: Neo4j Spring Data's orderBy placeholder handling lacks proper neutralization, allowing remote attackers to perform blind Cypher injections and exfiltrate or manipulate database contents.
items.reason_zh: Neo4j Spring Data 的 orderBy 占位符处理缺乏适当的安全过滤，允许远程攻击者执行盲注 Cypher 注入并窃取或篡改数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology contains an easily exploitable HTTP vulnerability that permits unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise financial management middleware.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology 存在一个易于利用的 HTTP 漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者攻破财务管理中间件。

items.reason_en: Oracle Hyperion Financial Close Management exposes an SMB-based vulnerability that, while difficult to exploit, still poses a significant risk to enterprise financial reconciliation data.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Financial Close Management 暴露了一个基于 SMB 的漏洞，尽管利用难度较高，但仍对企业财务对账数据构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: EnterpriseDB PEM agent certificates grant excessive pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files privileges. Compromising a single monitored host exposes all underlying database storage.
items.reason_zh: EnterpriseDB PEM 代理证书授予了过高的 pg_read_server_files 和 pg_write_server_files 权限。攻陷单个监控主机将导致所有底层数据库存储暴露。

items.reason_en: Insecure search_path configuration in PEM SECURITY DEFINER functions enables privilege escalation to superuser. Database administrators must enforce strict schema isolation to prevent exploitation.
items.reason_zh: PEM SECURITY DEFINER 函数中不安全的 search_path 配置可导致提权至超级用户。数据库管理员必须实施严格的模式隔离以防止被利用。

items.reason_en: Splunk SOAR container scope bypass via REST API allows unauthorized access to sensitive credentials and product data. Security orchestration workflows risk exposing critical investigation artifacts.
items.reason_zh: 通过 REST API 绕过 Splunk SOAR 容器作用域限制，可未经授权访问敏感凭证和产品数据。安全编排工作流面临泄露关键调查工件的风险。

items.reason_en: Global state memory corruption in PHP occurs when request memory is freed but pointers remain active, leading to remote code execution; actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV).
items.reason_zh: PHP 的全局状态内存损坏发生在请求内存释放但指针仍保持活跃时，可导致远程代码执行；该漏洞已在野外被积极利用（CISA KEV）。

items.reason_en: Partially overwritten session files in PHP's default save handler can be exploited for remote code execution when writes are interrupted or truncated.
items.reason_zh: PHP 默认保存处理程序中的部分覆盖会话文件可在写入中断或截断时被利用以执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: PHP-FPM request smuggling arises when unread HTTP bodies are retained across backend connection reuse, allowing attackers to bypass frontend WAFs and manipulate routing.
items.reason_zh: 当后端连接复用期间保留未读取的 HTTP 请求体时，PHP-FPM 会出现请求走私漏洞，使攻击者能够绕过前端 WAF 并操纵路由。

items.reason_en: Authenticated RCE in FlowiseAI stems from insecure module usage within the nodevm sandbox, enabling VM escape and direct host system compromise.
items.reason_zh: FlowiseAI 的已认证远程代码执行漏洞源于 nodevm 沙箱内模块使用不安全，可实现虚拟机逃逸并直接攻陷宿主机系统。

items.reason_en: Postgrex interpolates channel names directly into SQL commands for listen/unlisten operations, exposing database connections to SQL injection.
items.reason_zh: Postgrex 在 listen/unlisten 操作中直接将频道名称拼接到 SQL 命令中，使数据库连接面临 SQL 注入风险。

items.reason_en: Erlang inets httpd ignores max_clients limits under certain conditions, allowing unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources via connection flooding.
items.reason_zh: 特定条件下 Erlang inets httpd 会忽略 max_clients 限制，允许未认证攻击者通过连接洪水耗尽服务器资源。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in IBM Guardium edge-controller compromises database confidentiality and allows unauthorized data modification.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium edge-controller 存在未认证 SQL 注入漏洞，破坏数据库机密性并允许未经授权的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in PHP-FPM epoll backend allows local privilege escalation on affected web server deployments.
items.reason_zh: PHP-FPM epoll 后端的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可导致受影响 Web 服务器部署的本地提权。

items.reason_en: Pip bundles compromised eMudhra certificates, undermining TLS verification and enabling man-in-the-middle attacks across Python ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Pip 捆绑了遭篡改的 eMudhra 证书，削弱了 TLS 验证机制，并使 Python 生态系统面临中间人攻击风险。

items.reason_en: RepoManager accepts untrusted package metadata submissions, allowing attackers to poison self-hosted repository inventories and update streams.
items.reason_zh: RepoManager 接受不受信任的软件包元数据提交，使攻击者能够污染自托管仓库清单和更新源。

items.reason_en: isomorphic-git fails to reject Windows NTFS reserved pathnames like .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION during tree validation, enabling path traversal attacks during repository cloning or checkout.
items.reason_zh: isomorphic-git 在树验证期间未能拒绝 .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION 等 Windows NTFS 保留路径名，导致在克隆或检出仓库时可发生路径遍历攻击。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in libumqtt can trigger denial of service, memory corruption, or information disclosure, posing risks to lightweight IoT and messaging protocol implementations.
items.reason_zh: libumqtt 中的整数下溢可能触发拒绝服务、内存损坏或信息泄露，对轻量级物联网及消息协议实现构成风险。

items.reason_en: mcp-ssh-manager constructs remote shell commands using caller-controlled values, allowing authenticated users to inject arbitrary commands during SSH backup and restore operations.
items.reason_zh: mcp-ssh-manager 使用调用方控制的值构造远程 Shell 命令，允许已认证用户在 SSH 备份和恢复操作期间注入任意命令。

items.reason_en: llama.cpp's GGUF metadata loader contains an integer overflow that bypasses block count checks, risking out-of-bounds tensor writes and potential model exploitation in AI inference pipelines.
items.reason_zh: llama.cpp 的 GGUF 元数据加载器存在整数溢出漏洞，可绕过块计数检查，导致越界张量写入，并在 AI 推理流水线中引发潜在模型利用风险。

items.reason_en: ToolUniverse's Python sandbox lacks proper attribute restrictions, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. AI tool execution environments face immediate compromise without authentication barriers.
items.reason_zh: ToolUniverse 的 Python 沙箱缺乏适当的属性限制，允许未认证远程代码执行。AI 工具执行环境在无认证屏障的情况下面临立即被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Node.js HTTP/2 stream teardown use-after-free leaks response memory from unrelated connections. Web applications using HTTP/2 may inadvertently expose sensitive data to peers.
items.reason_zh: Node.js HTTP/2 流拆除阶段的释放后使用漏洞会泄漏无关连接的响应内存。使用 HTTP/2 的 Web 应用可能无意中向对等端泄露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: JetBrains TeamCity exposes an unauthenticated command server via the TFS helper process, risking full CI/CD pipeline compromise and artifact tampering.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains TeamCity 通过 TFS 辅助进程暴露了未认证的命令服务器，可能导致整个 CI/CD 流水线被攻陷及工件被篡改。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SPL execution in Splunk Enterprise allows attackers to read or modify sensitive data and configurations without proper role validation.
items.reason_zh: Splunk Enterprise 中未认证的 SPL 执行允许攻击者在缺乏适当角色验证的情况下读取或修改敏感数据和配置。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in IBM Guardium's SharePoint Tap component enables unauthenticated remote code execution on data protection appliances.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium 的 SharePoint Tap 组件存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，可在数据保护设备上实现未认证远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Workflow expression evaluation in n8n lacks proper sandbox isolation, allowing authenticated users to escape restricted contexts and execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: n8n 的工作流表达式评估缺乏适当的沙箱隔离，允许已认证用户突破受限上下文并执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: The Gleam compiler incorporates unvalidated dependency names into filesystem paths, enabling arbitrary file modification during package resolution.
items.reason_zh: Gleam 编译器将未经验证的依赖项名称拼接到文件系统路径中，导致在包解析期间可发生任意文件修改。

items.reason_en: Gleam's dependency resolution lacks sufficient authenticity verification, leaving it vulnerable to MITM substitution of forged Hex packages.
items.reason_zh: Gleam 的依赖项解析缺乏足够的真实性验证，使其易受中间人攻击替换伪造的 Hex 软件包的影响。

items.reason_en: Erlang OTP's certificate validation incorrectly accepts non-CA certificates as intermediate issuers, facilitating certificate chain forgery.
items.reason_zh: Erlang OTP 的证书验证机制错误地将非 CA 证书接受为中间签发机构，从而导致证书链伪造。

items.reason_en: Electrum fails to verify signatures on unconfirmed transactions, enabling malicious servers to replace or swallow user payments.
items.reason_zh: Electrum 未能验证未确认交易的签名，致使恶意服务器可替换或吞没用户支付款项。

items.reason_en: PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade undermines archive integrity checks and can facilitate malware distribution.
items.reason_zh: 通过算法降级绕过 PHAR 的 OpenSSL 签名验证会破坏归档文件完整性校验，进而可能导致恶意软件传播。
